chibi-portrait-undead-abomination.subject: PORTRAIT:UNDEAD:JUGGERNAUT

override.reason: The automatic mask minus four components on the face: the red iris of the big left eye (19..26, 15..19), the red rims of the small right eye (38..41, 13..14 and 37..41, 19..20) and a red stitched cheek patch (11..23, 23..31); plus the 75 deep crimson shades of the smock that touch the remaining mask, so the smock recolours whole while the eyes never turn teal or coral. No QA code is waived.

chibi-portrait-undead-abomination.notes: Abomination bust: huge stitched head with mismatched eyes over a red patchwork smock; override keeps the red eyes and cheek out and adds the deep smock shades (21.4%).

chibi-portrait-undead-banshee.subject: PORTRAIT:UNDEAD:MARKSMAN

override.reason: The automatic mask plus the 100 deep crimson shades of the hood and shroud that touch it (the keyLike band); without them a Teal Banshee kept dark red folds. No QA code is waived.

chibi-portrait-undead-banshee.notes: Banshee bust: wailing pale-blue face with raised hands under a red hooded shroud; override adds the deep crimson folds (24.7%).

chibi-portrait-undead-ghoul.subject: PORTRAIT:UNDEAD:RAIDER

chibi-portrait-undead-lich.subject: PORTRAIT:UNDEAD:CATAPULT

override.reason: The automatic mask plus the 144 deep crimson folds of the royal robe that touch it (the keyLike band); without them a Teal Lich kept dark red folds. No QA code is waived.

chibi-portrait-undead-lich.notes: Lich bust: iron crown on an ivory skull, stiff-collared red robe, blue flame in the bone hand; override adds the deep crimson robe folds (28.4%).

chibi-portrait-undead-necromancer.subject: PORTRAIT:UNDEAD:CAPTAIN
chibi-portrait-undead-necromancer.notes: Necromancer bust: glowing eyes, ivory beard, red hood and robe, skull staff with a blue flame; auto mask 24.9%.

chibi-portrait-undead-skeleton.subject: PORTRAIT:UNDEAD:FIGHTER

override.reason: The automatic mask plus the 38 deeper key-like shades of the crest and tabard hems that touch it (the keyLike band), so no crimson shading stays red for another owner. No QA code is waived.

chibi-portrait-undead-skeleton.notes: Skeleton bust: ivory skull, iron half-helmet with red crest, red ragged tabard, notched sword; matches the map Skeleton; override adds the deep crest and hem shades (27.7%).
